scope: Phase 1 read-only audit of current blocker logic in D:/okx/harmonic_agent
measurement_reason: The code exposes many blocker reasons, but it does not yet persist structured blocker counts by mode, setup, symbol category, direction, score bucket, and market_event_id. Blocked candidate counts and block rates below are therefore not measured from runtime data.

blockers.condition: best market-router score below MARKET_ROUTER_MIN_CONFIDENCE, NO_TRADE dominates, or score gap too small
blockers.reason: This is the master gate that can block all four modes. It is necessary, but it needs persisted counts by selectedMarketState, secondBestState, scoreGap, and routingConfidence before changing thresholds.

blockers.condition: market owner is another mode
blockers.reason: Ownership prevents mode collisions on the same symbol. It should remain, but the UI/performance store should measure whether the chosen owner later produced positive or negative expectancy.

blockers.condition: MacroSniper rejects ADX < 22
blockers.reason: This protects MacroSniper from ranging markets. It may also reject early trend transitions. Convert only after replay proves better expectancy.

blockers.condition: MacroSniper rejects declining ADX momentum when ADX < 30
blockers.reason: Likely useful against false continuation, but it needs evidence by trend pullback and momentum continuation setup.

blockers.condition: MacroSniper altcoin requires dual 1h/4h trend resonance
blockers.reason: Strict alignment can protect against noisy altcoins, but may undertrade high-volume breakouts. Needs category-specific outcome data.

blockers.condition: MeanReversion rejects ADX > 32 and rising
blockers.reason: This prevents fading strong active trends. It is appropriate until shadow data proves a separate failed-extension setup can profit.

blockers.condition: MeanReversion rejects entries against strong 4h trend
blockers.reason: This is correct for avoiding trend runs, but may suppress profitable short scalp snapbacks if no separate 1m/3m fast-exit engine exists.

blockers.condition: MeanReversion requires RSI < 42 for bullish or RSI > 58 for bearish
blockers.reason: RSI bands are reasonable for current mode. For short scalp, RSI should become one feature in quality scoring rather than a universal hard block.

blockers.condition: Contrarian requires divergence, liquidity sweep, or reversal wick
blockers.reason: Contrarian without exhaustion proof is structurally dangerous. Keep this hard block until replay can separate failed-breakout setup quality.

blockers.condition: Contrarian requires extreme RSI threshold
blockers.reason: Current thresholds favor safety. Outcome should be measured by RSI bucket, wick ratio, and sweep distance.

blockers.condition: SqueezeHunter requires breakout volume ratio
blockers.reason: Volume confirmation is central to squeeze breakout quality. It should be measured by major versus altcoin categories before tuning.

blockers.condition: SqueezeHunter requires squeeze detected in last 8 candles
blockers.reason: Without recent compression, SqueezeHunter degenerates into generic momentum chasing. Future failed-breakout logic should be a separate setup type.

blockers.condition: entry not in PRZ
blockers.reason: PRZ anchoring prevents bad fills but may be too slow for scalp breakouts. ShortScalpEngine should use its own setup-specific entry zone.

blockers.condition: profit room below active_min_profit
blockers.reason: This protects net profitability after fees. It should be retained and made bps-based for short scalp candidates.

blockers.condition: true RR below tuned target RR
blockers.reason: True live-price RR is essential. Threshold should not be relaxed without replay/OOS proof.

blockers.condition: mature strategy PF < 1.05 or expectancy < 0
blockers.reason: Mode-level blocking is useful but coarse. Phase 7 should block Mode+Setup+Category+Direction combinations independently.

blockers.condition: expected gross target cannot cover estimated cost and minimum net edge
blockers.reason: This prevents fee/slippage negative expectancy. Short scalp must strengthen this into explicit bps accounting.

blockers.condition: existing active trade lacks verified TP/SL protection
blockers.reason: No new exposure should be added while existing exposure lacks verified protection.

blockers.condition: OKX live position lacks verified TP/SL protection
blockers.reason: Exchange-side unprotected positions must block new entries. This is a safety invariant.

blockers.condition: bounded limit not filled
blockers.reason: No-chase execution reduces slippage but may miss profitable scalp moves. Shadow tracking should measure missed MFE after no-fill events.

blockers.condition: protection placement or verification failure
blockers.reason: Protection failure is the highest-severity live risk. It needs incident counts, symbols, exchange codes, and recovery outcomes.
